find: const x = p && p.alive ? p.pos.x + (b.pos.x - p.pos.x) * alpha : b.pos.x;
why: Places the row at the shell's tick position while entities.ts draws the shell at its interpolated one. At 60Hz a normal shell moves 0.1 units a tick, so between ticks the row would slide up to a tick's travel out of step with the shell it belongs to -- a stutter on the cue, and a gap or overlap the count is read across.
killedBy: shell bounce-trail system (issue #688) follows the interpolated shell, not the tick position
